messages:
alex: Deploy-bot flagged canary traffic tilt for v2.5.0 — p95 up, 5xx rate increased. Deploy-bot suggested auto-rollback but we held. Change window ends in ~45m. Need a decision: manual rollback -> v2.4.2 or pin + throttle?

deploy-bot: [SYSTEM] Auto-rollback evaluation: p95=420ms (threshold 300ms), 5xx=2.4% (threshold 1%). Suggest rollback to previous stable v2.4.2. Recommended actions: run `deploybot rollback --target canary --to v2.4.2` OR approve manual rollback.

mira: What customer-facing impact? any 500s seen from specific customers?

alex: Mostly /generate path and some dedicated pool routes (pool-1..3). No pager yet but SLO alert group firing. No spike in auth errors.

jordan: I vote manual rollback. We should avoid letting canary propagate. Also suggest pinning the older stable on Dedicated so clients don't drift. If we rollback,/someone should run the pin command afterwards.

ops-oncall: I can execute rollback. Confirm command and I’ll run. Also need a quick release-note blurb and a comms owner for #prod-incidents.

alex: Command to run: ```
deploybot rollback --target canary --to v2.4.2 --no-wait
``` After rollback, pin to prevent auto promotion: ```
deploybot pin --service inference --version v2.4.2 --duration 2h
```

deploy-bot: Note: rollback will drain existing connections and may temporarily increase latency for ~3-5m. Full traffic rebalancing estimated 6-10m.

mira: PM OK with rollback. We'll send a short customer note after we verify stability. @sophie can you draft a one-paragraph update?

sophie: Yep — short draft: "We observed increased latency on a canary release (v2.5.0) and rolled back to v2.4.2 while we investigate root cause. No action required by customers; we will follow up once we have more details." Will post after ops confirms stable. :thumbsup:

jordan: Alex/ops-oncall — we good to proceed? I’ll keep eyes on dashboards and open an incident if errors continue.

ops-oncall: executing now...
```
> deploybot rollback --target canary --to v2.4.2 --no-wait
```

deploy-bot: Rollback started by ops-oncall at 3456789030. Steps: 1) drain canary nodes, 2) update routing rules, 3) health-check verification. Estimated finalization in ~6m.

alex: Monitoring p95 and error-rate. tagging #prod-latency and #customer-notify for visibility.

ops-oncall: Rollback complete. Health checks passing, p95 trending down to normal range. Pin applied: `deploybot pin --service inference --version v2.4.2 --duration 2h`.

deploy-bot: Rollback finished at 3456789062. All canary replicas replaced. Notifying on-call and SRE runbook owner.

alex: Thanks. Sophie — send the note. Jordan — can you kick off a quick post-deploy evaluation doc (root-cause attempt + repro steps) so we can decide whether to reattempt v2.5.0?

jordan: On it. I’ll create the doc and invite infra + ML runtime to triage.

ops-oncall: Closing thread. If anything regresses I’ll reopen or page.

sophie: Posted customer blurb and added link to thread. :white_check_mark:
